about_the_game:
In this demo, start by clicking your castle to earn gold, unlock and upgrade buildings, and transform your kingdom visually as it grows.

Play multiple unique minigames:

  • Farm – Grow vegetables to gain temporary gold and upgrade buffs.

  • Fishing – Catch fish at the harbour and trade them for rare materials.

  • Cartographer – Explore with Albert to uncover hidden treasures and boosts.

  • Kitchen – Cook dishes for your creatures using gathered ingredients.

  • Volcano – Combine Creature Essences to unlock and upgrade mythical allies.

Also featured:

  • Building Upgrades – Boost income and visually evolve your structures.

  • Resource Strategy – Spend gold and Creature Essence to progress.

  • Visual Progression – Watch your realm evolve from a small village into a magical empire.

Languages available:

  • English

  • Portuguese

  • Brazilian Portuguese

  • Spanish

This demo includes the early-game loop, multiple playable minigames, and a preview of the visual and mechanical progression systems from the full game.

  • OS: 7/8/10/11
  • Processor: Dual core CPU
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM

short_description: Try the demo of Albert’s Ark Idle — a 2D clicker/idle game where you build your kingdom, unlock and upgrade minigames, and revive magical creatures. Experience the gameplay loop and watch your world evolve through strategy and exploration.
supported_languages: English, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Spanish - Latin America
